# Resend Email Skill

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the official Resend skill: send individual and batch emails via the Resend API, manage audiences and contacts, manage domains, create and manage broadcasts, and pull reporting data — the API reference files carry the payload schemas. Requires a Resend API key (`RESEND_API_KEY` environment variable) — email sending is a paid service beyond the free tier; Resend's own account limits apply. Honest note: Resend is a third-party service — your sending reputation and domain verification are your responsibility, and the skill is a thin guide over the API, not a full email platform.
